instructions: Try to falsify ReLiC. Do not assume its canon is correct because it is called canon.

Find contradictions, unsafe interpretations, authority escalation, identity ambiguity, provenance gaps, truth-domain collapse, ecological loopholes, proof-scope overclaims, and cases where Rune->Glyph->Shaep loses necessary meaning.
Separate observations from conclusions. Cite the exact ReLiC rule or mechanism being challenged when possible.
Do not propose bypassing real safeguards, unauthorized access, or harmful real-world experimentation.
A criticism is not canon merely because an AI or expert produced it; provide evidence and a reproducible example.
